valid_domain: Correctly initialized active algorithm object for the selected precision, valid fixed map/gain tables and allocated scratch capacity; stable configured channel count N in{4,9,16}. Prior findings establish those configuration branches.

For positive frames, first input and output bus descriptors, N input/output channel pointers and each storage extent are valid; frame count is nonnegative and no larger than configured scratch/buffer capacity.

For host-valid silence probes, every input plane whose silenceFlags bit is set contains only zero samples and still has valid allocated memory, matching the retained public VST3 header. Unflagged planes may remain nonzero; arbitrary nonzero data in a flagged plane is not a valid-host conformance case.

The precision byte at processor+0x168 matches prior activation/setup and actual storage precision. This process body does not validate ProcessData.symbolicSampleSize before selecting algorithm pointers.
Successful parameter values are finite normalized values in[0,1]; nonfinite/out-of-range parameter behavior is not generalized from decompiler comparisons.

Normal in-place equivalence is bounded to distinct input channels and distinct output channels, with each output either exactly its corresponding input or disjoint storage; scratch planes are valid and disjoint. Cross-channel or partial overlap is not included.
External virtual parameter queues and imported meter/scaling functions conform to their called contracts. Static branch observations do not certify dynamic library behavior, FPCR or host state.

parameter_state.successful_update: For parameterID1, getPoint(getPointCount()-1, &sampleOffset, &value); only numeric return0 commits the byte. FCMP D0,0.5; CSET GT; STRB to processor+0x169 at0x1521e4..0x1521ec. For finite[0,1] values bypass becomes1 iff value>0.5; exactly0.5 is off.
parameter_state.timing: The selected last queue point affects the current entire dispatched block; returned sampleOffset is not read. Earlier points in the same queue are not individually processed by this consumer.
parameter_state.no_update: Absent queue, no matchingID1 or unsuccessful getPoint leaves prior bypass byte unchanged in this consumer. PointCount0 is not explicitly guarded before requesting index-1; valid host queue behavior is a precondition.
parameter_state.zero_frame_effect: A successful bypass or direction update can persist on a zero-frame call before the early return; the next block need not resend it.
parameter_state.constructor_observation: 0x15206c..0x152074 zero the fields through byte+0x169; 0x152078/0x152080 write0x0101 at+0x16a, enabling both meter bytes in the traced constructor. The base constructor identity/calling convention and subsequent lifecycle writes remain preconditions.
parameter_state.direction_distinction: DirectionID2 uses a separate threshold branch (finitevalue>=0.5 chooses the high table pair); bypass uses strict>.5. Existing AMBI-PARAM-001/AMBI-DSP findings are preserved.

bypass_contract.rule: For i=0..N-1 in ascending order: if input[i]==output[i], skip that channel; otherwise copy frames samples from input[i] to output[i]. No gain table, direction map or scratch array is used in these wrappers.
float_evidence: 0x154e7c..0x154e88 copy call to0x16a0fc and next iteration
double_evidence: 0x154bb8..0x154bc4 copy call to0x16a14c and next iteration
bypass_contract.copy_helpers: Float0x16a0fc copies4samples per vector iteration then0..3 scalar tail samples. Double0x16a14c copies8samples per vector iteration when count>=8 and unsigned(dst-src)>=64bytes; otherwise/for remainder it copies forward scalar samples. Neither is claimed to be memmove for arbitrary overlap.
bypass_contract.bounded_implication: For valid disjoint channel storage or corresponding exact in-place buffers, bypass preserves source sample bit patterns and channel order through the inspected copy instructions. No runtime validation, interpolation, smoothing or latency claim is added.
exclusions: Cross-channel aliasing can be order-sensitive because each channel is copied directly before the next.
Partial overlap and duplicate output planes are outside this contract.
Calling bypass helper directly with zero frames would reach no sample load/store in its copy helpers, but the actual process entry returns before invoking it.

normal_alias_contract.trigger: Scan only corresponding pointer pairs input[i],output[i] for i=0..N-1. If ANY pair is exactly equal, stage ALL N input planes into scratch before any remapped output copy.
normal_alias_contract.no_match: If no corresponding pair is equal, directly scatter input[i] to output[map[i]] in ascending source-index order; no general range-overlap search occurs.
normal_alias_contract.post_step: The existing conversion wrapper then scales each destination channel with gain[destination], after either permutation path; first/higher-order math findings remain unchanged.
normal_alias_contract.bounded_implication: Under valid allocated scratch and corresponding-only exact aliasing/disjointness, full in-place or mixed corresponding in-place conversion follows the same scatter-then-destination-gain rule as disjoint conversion.
exclusions: A cross-channel equality input[i]==output[j] for i!=j does not itself trigger staging.
Buffer range overlap is not detected by this scan.
Changing N or frame capacity after allocation, failed allocation, overlapping scratch planes, duplicated output planes and malformed maps are not covered.

silence_and_meter_limits: The native64-bit CBZ at0x153f88 distinguishes only zero versus nonzero input mask; it does not test all channels silent, popcount, or only currently valid channel bits.

For bypass==0 with nonzero mask, normal conversion is skipped even when only one bit is set. This is a conditional branch observation; host behavior and whether such masks reach this state are not measured.
The mask is copied unchanged at0x153f94; there is no map-based flag permutation in that store. This does not by itself establish complete VST silence conformance or a product defect.

Input metering precedes the silence decision and output metering follows it. Both paths explicitly load each first sample (float0x153ee0/0x154060; double0x153e44/0x153fd8) before calling the corresponding max-magnitude import with frame count. Silence flags are not a permission to supply invalid buffers in this observed path.

This finding does not claim all memory is untouched on a silence-skipped block: flags, meter state and accumulator may change; output buffers are read when output metering is enabled; imported meter/publication behavior is not fully analyzed here.
Complete meter emission behavior, smoothing, allocation/lifecycle transitions and arbitrary precision-state failures remain outside this bounded contract.

prospective_disconfirming_cases.setup: In a valid initialized state, use zero frames and a successful finalID1 value>0.5; retain distinct output flags/data sentinels; then run a positive block with no new parameter queue.
prospective_disconfirming_cases.static_prediction: First call performs parameter update then returns0 without audio/meter/flag/counter work; next positive block chooses bypass. A mismatch would challenge ordering/persistence or host-state assumptions.

prospective_disconfirming_cases.setup: Use lastID1 values nextbelow(0.5), exactly0.5 and nextabove(0.5), with earlier conflicting points and varying last sampleOffset.
prospective_disconfirming_cases.static_prediction: For finite values, only last>0.5 enables bypass for the whole dispatched block. Position-dependent transitions would disconfirm the bounded consumer interpretation.

prospective_disconfirming_cases.setup: Bypass off, positive frames, valid input planes and distinct output sentinel buffers; vary silenceFlags0,1 and allNbits. Zero all samples of each flagged input plane; retain nonzero patterns only in unflagged planes. Retain meter-state context.
prospective_disconfirming_cases.static_prediction: Mask0 invokes conversion; every nonzero mask skips it and reaches unchanged-mask store. Do not expect synthesized zeros solely from flags; observed output zeros could also originate in host behavior.

prospective_disconfirming_cases.setup: Repeat the host-valid nonzero-mask case with bypass enabled; use disjoint buffers, zero every flagged input plane and use distinct nonzero patterns in unflagged channels.
prospective_disconfirming_cases.static_prediction: Bypass copies same-index samples despite nonzero mask, then propagates mask. A skipped copy would challenge dispatch order or called-state assumptions.

prospective_disconfirming_cases.setup: For each supportedN, precision and direction, compare disjoint output with all corresponding buffers equal, then only one corresponding pair equal. Use distinct channels/multiframe data and valid scratch capacity.
prospective_disconfirming_cases.static_prediction: Any equal pair stages all inputs; output numerical operator should match the disjoint path within the previously stated FP limits.

prospective_disconfirming_cases.setup: In a controlled future harness only, introduce cross-channel equality with no corresponding equality, or partial overlap, while retaining exact memory layout.
prospective_disconfirming_cases.static_prediction: The specific staging guard is not selected by cross-channel equality alone; no faithful-output prediction is made. This probes the excluded domain, not a conformance test the current candidate supports.
